title: Retain the specified initial background and its zero logical effect
statement: For a pre-existing common length-ell strip and unconditional tip Hamiltonian h*X_tip, the actual native generator has an invariant2(ell+1)-state sector. Common erosion advances independently at ratekappa; activation delay is Gamma(ell,kappa). The tip/bath channel is exactly survival*U_T plus the integral of the continuing native correction channel F_(T-s) after U_s, with the SAME persistent bath throughout. For B=I and h/kappa=1/64,T=32pi/kappa,ell=512, tip occupation exceeds1-exp(-420) by the supplied Poisson/rational exponential argument, not a large simulation. This defeats a background-uniform physical h²/kappa replacement. The strip is not cold encoded input; its acquisition/probability under continual faults must be paid. Below the inherited contractible filling cutoff, the SAME fixed decoder corrects the entire coherent strip span and its logical error effect is exactlyZERO. It is not a cold-start logical-memory failure.
